extraction_notes: Public Leshan Radio Company (LRC) datasheet, Rev.B Mar 2016, 5 pages; covers LMBT3904LT1G and S-LMBT3904LT1G (S- prefix is the AEC-Q101 automotive variant, electrically identical tables). Extracted identity is S-LMBT3904LT1G. SOT23 (TO-236), marking 1AM.

All table values are guaranteed bounds; the datasheet publishes no typical scalar values, and no bound was converted to a typical. The hFE row at IC = 10 mA carries both a 100 minimum and a 300 maximum and is represented as two gain_points rows.
SI units used throughout: currents in A, voltages in V, capacitances in F, transition frequency in Hz. Curve points converted from mA axis labels to A.

Curves on pp. 3-4 were digitized by eye from the typical-characteristics figures at the 25 degC curve only; values are approximate (roughly 5-10% reading uncertainty, worse near steep roll-offs). The DC Current Gain figure does not print its VCE bias; the table hFE conditions use VCE = 1.0 V.
Curves not digitized: capacitance vs reverse voltage (log-log, sparse axis labels), collector saturation region VCE vs IB, transient Rthja vs time, and the 150 degC / -55 degC temperature branches.
No vendor SPICE model content was used; extraction is from the public datasheet only.
